name: novita_ai
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM chat, completions, embeddings and rerank on Novita AI
long_description: Bring a Novita AI API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the account balance (GET /openapi/v1/billing/balance/detail), which runs no model and costs nothing. A Sprite can then list and read models, run chat and text completions (including SSE streaming), create embeddings and rerank documents through the OpenAI-compatible API under /openai/v1, and read the balance. Every completion, embedding and rerank request is billed to your Novita AI balance per token. Batches and files, image, audio and video generation, web search, GPU instances, serverless GPU endpoints, API key policies, team budgets, transactions and bill listings are not forwarded.

presentation.tagline: Run Novita AI's OpenAI-compatible LLMs from a Sprite without putting your API key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at novita.ai, open Settings → Key Management and create an API key (it starts with `sk_`). The full key is shown only once. Model access restrictions set on the key still apply. Novita applies a key's Network Access allow-list to model calls only, so a key with one passes the key check but is refused on model calls (403 `ip_access_denied`) unless the list is empty or allows the gateway.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /openapi/v1/billing/balance/detail`, which runs no model and costs nothing. Chat completions, text completions, embeddings and rerank are billed per token against your Novita AI balance at each model's price on novita.ai/pricing. A request that is cut off or disconnected after the model has started is still billed for the tokens used; set `max_tokens` to cap it. `GET /openai/v1/models` returns chat models' prices per million tokens in 1/10000 USD; embedding and rerank models are not in that list. Listing and reading models and reading the balance are free.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /openai/v1/models`, `GET /openai/v1/models/:model`, `GET /openai/v1/models/:owner/:model`, `POST /openai/v1/chat/completions`, `POST /openai/v1/completions`, `POST /openai/v1/embeddings`, `POST /openai/v1/rerank` and `GET /openapi/v1/billing/balance/detail` are forwarded. The balance route is also the key check, so a Sprite can read the account balance. Batches and files, image, audio and video generation, web search, GPU instances and serverless endpoints, API key policies, team budgets, transactions and bill listings are not.

usage_notes: Point an OpenAI SDK at the gateway's `/openai/v1` base; model ids look like `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`.

Errors are `{"code": 401, "reason": "FAILED_TO_AUTH", "message": "...", "metadata": {}}`. Novita's docs give 401 for a wrong key and also list 403 `INVALID_API_KEY`. Other 403s mean a valid key that lacks balance, model access or identity verification, or one whose Network Access allow-list does not allow the gateway (`ip_access_denied`).
Non-streaming generations that run longer than 120 seconds hit the gateway's response deadline; use `stream: true` for long outputs.
